name: io.github.bugiiiii11/rein
title: Rein
description: Spend limits for AI agents that pay with x402: every paywall is policy-checked before a cent moves.

environmentVariables.name: REIN_AGENT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the rein-agent.json written by `npx @reinconsole/init` (engine URL, agent id, API key, wallet).

environmentVariables.name: REIN_ENGINE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Policy engine base URL. Required unless REIN_AGENT_FILE is set.

environmentVariables.name: REIN_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The one agent this server speaks for. Required unless REIN_AGENT_FILE is set.

environmentVariables.name: REIN_ENGINE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer key for the engine, ideally an evaluate key narrowed to this agent.

environmentVariables.name: REIN_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent wallet key. Omit for advisory mode: policy is checked, nothing is paid.

environmentVariables.name: REIN_NETWORK_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: testnet (default) or mainnet: which network's 402s this server will pay.
